social.text: @ gabrielesvelto Yes. Plenty of metaphors: So much of this Ai interaction is so creatively numbing. All the routes to completion you would normally take, all the discoveries you make on the way, to inform your creative decisions….they get thrown into the chipper. Reduced to a single ‘magic bullet’ prompt that produces something that’s by its very nature is derivative and bland. Breaks my heart to hear editors saying that animation can be reduced to this. For years, I had to teach some of my biggest clients that animation was a *process* that involved passes: refinement. Each stage is about finessing - with intent. Now we all sit at the slot machines tray and wait of for a single magical payout (while our coin pile dwindles) . Humans, we are better than this! # aisucks # ai # animation
